chunks.text: Next.js App Router route table legend for SkinBB: ƒ means a dynamic route (server-rendered on demand or with ISR). ○ means a static route. When shown, revalidate is the ISR interval (e.g. 1h, 5m, 1d) and expire is the stale-while-revalidate-style cache hint from the build output. User-facing navigation should use these paths as the source of truth.

Canonical published App Router routes: / (ƒ). /_not-found (○). /about (○, revalidate 1h, expire 1y). /account/addresses, /account/coupons, /account/orders, /account/rewards, /account/rewards/badges, /account/rewards/history, /account/shelf, /account/shelf/add, /account/wishlist, /account/profile (○). /account/orders/[orderId] (ƒ). /account/profile/edit (ƒ). /api/auth/[...nextauth] (ƒ). /api/revalidate (ƒ). /api/rewards/animation/[...parts] (ƒ). /apple-icon.png (○). /bbshop (○, revalidate 5m, expire 1y). /blog, /blog/[slug], /blog/category/[category], /blog/tag/[tag] (ƒ). /brands (○). /checkout (ƒ). /checkout/failure (ƒ). /checkout/sign-in (ƒ). /checkout/success (○). /community (○). /community/q/[slug] (ƒ). /help (○). /help/[slug] (ƒ). /icon.png (○). /knowledge-feed (○). /knowledge-feed/[category], /knowledge-feed/[category]/[slug] (ƒ). /launch (○). /legal (○, revalidate 1d, expire 1y). /payment (○). /privacy-policy (○, revalidate 1d, expire 1y). /product/[slug], /product/[slug]/reviews (ƒ). /return-policy (○, revalidate 1d, expire 1y). /robots.txt (○). /shipping-policy (○, revalidate 1d, expire 1y). /shop (ƒ). /signin (ƒ). /site-password (○). /sitemap.xml (○). /terms-and-conditions (○, revalidate 1d, expire 1y).

Module: Global and marketing. Home is /. About is /about (static page with about 1h revalidate in build). Sign in is /signin (dynamic ƒ). Utility: /site-password and /launch (static). Discovery for crawlers: /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml (static). There is no /contact route in the published App Router list; prefer /help or site contact flows if the product exposes them elsewhere.

Module: Commerce — Shop. Main shop is /shop (ƒ dynamic). Alternate listing BB Shop is /bbshop (○ static with about 5m revalidate in build). Brand directory is /brands (○ static). Shop listing URLs can include query params for filters (search, category, brand, price, concerns, etc.).
Module: Commerce — Product pages. Product detail (PDP) is /product/[slug] (ƒ). Reviews hub is /product/[slug]/reviews (ƒ). Query params may still be used for API or SEO alongside slugs.

Feature: Knowledge Feed. Listing home /knowledge-feed (○ static). Category /knowledge-feed/[category] and post /knowledge-feed/[category]/[slug] are ƒ dynamic. Known category slugs in the UI include jargons, skinvestigators, stories (Real Life Stories). Post types can include long (video plus article), short stories, and jargon or slides style content.

Feature: Blog. Listing /blog (ƒ). Post /blog/[slug] (ƒ). Category /blog/category/[category] and tag /blog/tag/[tag] (ƒ). Query params on listing may still include q, tag, sort (newest, oldest, popular), or legacy category when not in the path. Blog and Knowledge Feed are different route trees.

Difference: Knowledge Feed versus Blog. Knowledge Feed uses /knowledge-feed (static home) with dynamic category and post segments. Blog uses /blog with dynamic listing, category, tag, and slug. Use /knowledge-feed for short-form tabs and tips; /blog for longer articles. Legacy /knowledge links may still exist off-site; on-site canonical pattern is /knowledge-feed.
Module: Community. Hub /community (○ static). Question threads /community/q/[slug] (ƒ dynamic). Teach users thread URLs as /community/q/{slug}.

Module: Account. Routes under /account require login in normal UX. Static account pages: /account/addresses, /account/coupons, /account/orders, /account/profile, /account/rewards, /account/rewards/badges, /account/rewards/history, /account/shelf, /account/shelf/add, /account/wishlist (○). Dynamic: /account/orders/[orderId] (ƒ), /account/profile/edit (ƒ). Unauthenticated users are typically redirected to sign-in with a callback back to the requested path.

Wishlist versus Shelf. Wishlist /account/wishlist (○) saves products to buy later. Shelf /account/shelf (○) and add flow /account/shelf/add (○) track products you own or use in a routine via catalog search.

Checkout and payment URLs. /checkout/sign-in (ƒ) gates checkout when auth is required. Main flow /checkout (ƒ). Outcomes: /checkout/success (○ static) and /checkout/failure (ƒ). There is also a standalone /payment page (○ static) in the app router output—use it only when the product sends users there; core checkout may still be centered on /checkout. Cart remains primarily the slide-out drawer rather than a /cart page in this route list.

Help and legal. Help hub /help (○ static). Article or category slug pages /help/[slug] (ƒ). FAQ-style content may still be loaded from backend APIs in the app even though routes are under /help. Legal hub /legal (○, about 1d revalidate in build). Policy pages (○, about 1d revalidate): /privacy-policy, /return-policy, /terms-and-conditions, /shipping-policy. Older marketing redirects like /policies to /legal may still exist in next.config—confirm in production if needed.

Internal API routes (not normal user navigation but useful for support): NextAuth handler at /api/auth/[...nextauth] (ƒ). On-demand revalidation endpoint /api/revalidate (ƒ). Rewards animation assets /api/rewards/animation/[...parts] (ƒ).

User flows. Browse to buy: home or /shop or /bbshop to /product/[slug], cart drawer, then /checkout (and /checkout/sign-in if needed), then /checkout/success or /checkout/failure; /payment may appear as part of product-specific payment UX. Orders: /account/orders then /account/orders/[orderId]. Owned products: /account/shelf and /account/shelf/add. Rewards and coupons: /account/rewards, badges, history, and /account/coupons. Help: /help then /help/[slug]. Legal: /legal or direct policy URLs.

Synonyms. SkinBB consumer brand; legal name Skin Beyond Borders on policy pages. BB Shop → /bbshop; generic shop → /shop or /bbshop. Skincare tips feed → /knowledge-feed. My account → /account/profile. Orders → /account/orders. Loyalty → /account/rewards; badges → /account/rewards/badges. Shelf vs wishlist as before. Sign in → /signin (ƒ). Community thread → /community/q/{slug}. Payment page path → /payment when applicable.

Dynamic versus static guidance for RAG. Do not treat as fixed text: live catalog, cart, user-specific account data, CMS FAQ bodies, and article bodies. Route paths and rendering style (ƒ vs ○) from the build table are stable reference; content behind dynamic routes changes with data.

Routes not in the published App Router list should not be promised as real pages—examples sometimes seen in old configs or sitemaps elsewhere include /cart, /search, /signup, /contact, /category/[slug] as a catalog page. In this build, cart is drawer-first; there is no /contact page listed. If a path is absent from the canonical route chunk, say you are not sure or point users to /help.
